title: Team Lead, Sales Support
description:
The Sales Support Team Lead is a key leadership role within Sales Enablement, responsible for overseeing a team of Sales Support Analysts who provide operational and transactional support to the Sales organization. This position serves as a subject matter expert and escalation point for complex sales processes, quote configuration, contract administration, and order management. The Team Lead partners closely with Sales, Renewals, Contracts, Billing, and IT teams to drive operational excellence, improve business processes, and ensure a seamless experience for internal stakeholders. In addition to managing daily operations, this role focuses on employee development, continuous improvement, and strategic initiatives that enhance organizational efficiency.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Sales Support Analysts, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct regular one\-on\-one meetings, performance discussions, and career development coaching.
* Recruit, onboard, train, and mentor new team members, ensuring operational readiness and knowledge transfer.
* Monitor team performance metrics and workload distribution to ensure service level commitments are met.


**Sales Operations Support**
* Oversee and manage the queue of incoming sales operations requests within Salesforce (SFDC), ensuring timely and accurate resolution.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex quoting, contract, and order\-related inquiries.
* Provide expert guidance to Account Executives on quote configuration, pricing, and sales processes within Salesforce and CPQ.
* Deliver white\-glove support for strategic and enterprise\-level opportunities, ensuring deal accuracy and operational compliance.
* Review and validate pricing and configurations for migration orders and other complex sales transactions.
* Process contract amendments and site consolidations in accordance with company policies and procedures.


**Process Improvement \& Operational Excellence**
* Ensure operational requests are accurately categorized and documented to support meaningful reporting and analytics.
* Analyze operational data and trends to identify opportunities for process optimization and efficiency gains.
* Lead and participate in cross\-functional initiatives focused on improving sales processes, systems, and overall business operations.
* Develop and maintain documentation, training materials, and best practices that support team consistency and scalability.
* Act as a liaison between Sales, Renewals, Contracts, Billing, IT, and other business partners to resolve issues and streamline workflows.


**What You'll Bring**
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, and develop high\-performing teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively partner across all levels of the organization.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to navigate complex situations professionally and confidently while maintaining a customer\-focused mindset.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms.

title: Media Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 South Matters is a dedicated South Indian news platform covering Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Kerala. The organization delivers timely news and analysis on politics, governance, cinema, culture, economy, technology, sports, and people’s stories from a distinctly South India perspective. By highlighting everything from breaking news and political developments to film industry updates, cultural heritage, and regional growth, South Matters amplifies the authentic voice of the region. Its mission is to ensure that stories from South India are told, shared, and celebrated with a global audience, making it a dynamic space for engaged viewers and partners.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Media Sales Executive role based in Hyderabad. The Media Sales Executive will identify and approach prospective advertisers, build strong client relationships, and promote South Matters’ media offerings across digital and other channels. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include prospecting and lead generation, preparing and delivering sales pitches, negotiating proposals and closing deals, and managing ongoing campaigns to meet client objectives. The role also involves coordinating with editorial and marketing teams to develop effective advertising solutions, preparing performance reports, and maintaining accurate sales documentation. The ideal candidate will consistently work to expand market presence, meet revenue targets, and represent South Matters professionally in all client interactions.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong Media Sales and Sales skills, with a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
* Proficiency in New Business Development and Lead Generation to identify and convert new advertising opportunities.
* Account Management experience, including maintaining long\-term client relationships and ensuring client satisfaction.
* Knowledge of digital media, advertising formats, and basic marketing concepts relevant to news and media platforms.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain value propositions clearly.
* Ability to work on\-site in Hyderabad, manage time effectively, and handle multiple client accounts simultaneously.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Media, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in media, advertising, or news organizations and familiarity with the South Indian market are advantageous.

title: Pre Sales Consultant
description:
PRE\-SALES EXECUTIVE –
   

  

**User Experience \& Design Consulting**
 Location: Hyderabad \| Experience: 6–8 years \| Level: Senior
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 We are looking for a commercially sharp Pre\-Sales / Sales Operations professional to
   

  

 power UX\-led pursuits, deal shaping and growth across complex enterprise
   

  

 engagements. This is not a purely external\-facing sales role — you will work closely with
   

  

 Sales, account teams, UX Leadership and Delivery, turning client requirements and
   

  

 internal inputs into sharp, high\-impact collaterals, pitches, proposals, commercials
   

  

 and deal structures.
   

  

 The role combines consulting mindset, commercial thinking and execution
   

  

 discipline — from understanding the ask and shaping the story to pricing the
   

  

 engagement, structuring the deal and running the internal pursuit engine end\-to\-end.
   

  

 Equally important is the ability to read the client pulse early, spot whitespace in
   

  

 Design/UX and steer conversations toward untapped opportunities.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Run the internal pre\-sales engine E2E — qualification, requirements, solution


 narratives, decks, proposals, SOWs, pricing, commercials, deal structuring and
   

  

 pursuit governance in close partnership with Sales and UX teams.
   

  

* Translate requirements into high\-impact sales collateral — executive decks,


 pitches, POVs, proposals, case studies and differentiated value propositions that
   

  

 make complex experience offerings clear and compelling.
   

  

* Shape the opportunity, not just respond to the brief — read between the lines,


 understand the client pulse and identify whitespace across UX, Design, Experience
   

  

 and digital transformation that can translate into expansion opportunities.
   

  

* Bring commercial rigor to every pursuit — structure premium professional


 offerings across relevant engagement models, balancing client value, scope,
   

  

 staffing, assumptions, risk, pricing and margin.
   

  

* Be the connective tissue across Sales, UX and Delivery, keeping pursuits moving


 with the right inputs, narrative, commercials and governance while continuously
   

  

 improving reusable offerings, playbooks and sales assets.
   

  

 What You Bring
   

  

* Experience in pre\-sales, Sales Operations, solution consulting, business


 development, experience/design consulting or digital transformation.
   

  

* Preferably from a Design Studio and/or Frog, Deloitte Digital, IBM iX, Accenture


 Song or equivalent environment.
   

  

* Strong Sales / Marketing orientation, ideally backed by an MBA/PGDM from a Tier\-


 II IIMs, MICA or equivalent business school.
   

  

* Hands\-on strength across content, storytelling, pricing and deal structuring, with


 the ability to turn ambiguous requirements into commercially sharp solutions and
   

  

 proposals.
   

  

* Strong technology grounding and enough fluency across digital, AI and enterprise


 technology to make client conversations around UX and transformation feel natural
   

  

 and credible.
   

  

* A go\-getter with commercial instinct — curious, adaptable and quick to connect


 dots, convert conversations into opportunities and grow into increasingly strategic
   

  

 responsibilities.
   

  

* Design Consulting background is a strong plus.


 Why This Role
   

  

* A high\-impact role at the intersection of Sales, Consulting, Design and Growth,


 with direct exposure to strategic accounts and senior leadership. You will help turn
   

  

 UX from a delivery capability into a premium professional oPering and meaningful
   

  

 growth engine — while owning the internal machinery that makes that growth
   

  

 happen.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like in 12 Months
   

  

* You are the go\-to partner for Sales and UX on high\-value pursuits, keeping the


 internal engine sharp, fast and commercially aligned.
   

  

* You have materially contributed to a strong UX\-led pipeline, including multiple


 $500K\+ opportunities and meaningful account expansion.
   

  

* You consistently identify latent Design/UX opportunities and help steer


 conversations from the immediate ask toward broader transformation possibilities.
   

  

* Proposals, pitches, pricing and deal structures are sharper, faster and more


 consistent, supported by reusable offerings and playbooks.
   

  

* You are trusted to move from “What did the client ask for?” to “What could we


 unlock next?” — with the commercial instinct and execution muscle to make it
   

  

 happen.

* Develop and execute territory, segment, and target\-account strategies aligned to India growth priorities, ideal customer profiles, and revenue objectives.

* Consistently achieve or exceed revenue, gross\-margin, new\-logo, pipeline coverage, and conversion objectives while protecting commercial quality.
* Represent Headfirst Global as a credible market voice at senior client forums, industry events, and strategic networking platforms.



  





**Client Engagement \& Solutions:** 



* Lead executive\-level discovery to uncover strategic priorities, operational pain points, risk considerations, decision criteria, and measurable success outcomes.

* Orchestrate cross\-functional solution design with Sales, Customer Success, Talent Management, Finance, Legal, and Operations, ensuring propositions are differentiated, deliverable, and commercially sound.
* Develop and present compelling business cases, proposals, and executive presentations that articulate value, return on investment, commercial logic, and implementation confidence.
* Lead complex negotiations across scope, commercials, service levels, risk, and contract terms, maintaining client trust while protecting margin and governance standards.
* Act as a customer advocate by bringing client insight into solution development, mobilizing internal support, and setting clear expectations that enable long\-term value realization.



  





**Pipeline Management \& Reporting:** 



* Maintain rigorous CRM discipline, complete opportunity data, and clear next\-step ownership across all active accounts and deals.

* Provide accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasts, clearly articulating assumptions, dependencies, decision paths, and recovery actions.
* Use data, market intelligence, and AI\-enabled sales tools to improve account prioritisation, research, outreach personalization, pipeline insight, and forecast quality while applying appropriate judgement and data safeguards.

* Operate within the delegation of authority, pricing, margin, contractual, compliance, and ethical frameworks; escalate exceptions early and with clear recommendations.

* Partner effectively across functions and geographies to mobilize expertise, remove barriers, and present one integrated HeadFirst Global experience to the client.
* Share winning practices, market insight, and constructive coaching with colleagues, contributing to continuous improvement in sales capability, process, and performance.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* Substantial B2B solution\-sales or business\-development experience, preferably in staffing, MSP, RPO, GCC, workforce solutions, technology\-enabled services, or professional services.
* Demonstrated record of winning new logos, meeting or exceeding revenue and margin targets, and closing complex, multi\-stakeholder opportunities.
* Strong proficiency in sales strategy, territory and account planning, consultative and value selling, opportunity qualification, commercial negotiation, and disciplined sales\-process execution.
* Advanced pipeline management and forecasting capability, with strong CRM discipline and the ability to convert data into practical deal and portfolio decisions.
* Credibility and confidence engaging C\-suite and senior functional leaders, with excellent executive communication, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
* Commercial acumen with the ability to develop business cases, articulate return on investment, understand pricing and margin implications, and balance customer value with organizational outcomes.
* AI fluency, including effective and responsible use of AI\-enabled tools for research, account intelligence, prospecting, personalization, proposal development, productivity, and sales analysis; able to validate outputs and protect confidential data.
* Strong customer\-advocacy orientation, with evidence of representing the customer voice internally, resolving barriers, and building relationships that support retention, expansion, and referrals.
* Sound understanding of the India commercial and workforce landscape, including relevant client buying dynamics, market trends, and regulatory considerations.
* High levels of ownership, resilience, judgement, collaboration, and adaptability in a fast\-growing, matrixed environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, or a related field; relevant advanced study or professional sales certification is advantageous.



  





**What We Offer:** 



* The opportunity to shape commercial growth across India's major metropolitan markets and represent a differentiated GCC and workforce solutions portfolio.

* A collaborative, ambitious, and customer\-led culture that values performance, ownership, innovation, and responsible use of technology.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
**Business Development Executive** 




**Loop by Zolo** 




**Build supply. Drive owner partnerships. Create the foundation for Loop’s expansion.** 




  





**Offered CTC:** 
 4\.5 LPA to 5\.5 LPA
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 Loop by Zolo is scaling its presence across cities by partnering with property owners and building vibrant, community\-led stays designed for young travellers.
 



 Growth starts with finding the right properties and the right owners.
 



 The challenge is not just identifying potential properties — it is
 **building trust with owners, understanding the asset, running structured conversations, and consistently moving opportunities forward** 
 .
 



 Most conversations do not convert because of poor follow\-ups, unstructured pitching, lack of persistence, or a mismatch between the property and what the business needs.
 



 This role exists to ensure that:
 


* Every owner interaction is
 **thoughtful and structured**
* Every potential property is
 **understood and qualified**
* Every opportunity is
 **tracked and progressed**
* Every conversation contributes to a
 **growing, high\-quality supply pipeline**



 If the Business Development Executive is strong, the supply pipeline builds consistently and the right properties move towards closure.
 



 If the Business Development Executive is weak, opportunities drop, follow\-ups break, unsuitable properties consume time, and expansion slows.
 



  





**Your mandate is clear** 



* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of property owner conversations
* Identify properties that could fit the Loop proposition
* Drive consistent outreach and field meetings
* Run structured, insight\-driven owner conversations
* Understand owner expectations and identify deal blockers
* Ensure disciplined follow\-ups and deal progression
* Maintain clean and reliable pipeline data



 This is not a coordination role.
 



 It is a
 **field\-driven, execution\-heavy, ownership role** 
 with direct impact on Loop’s expansion.
 



  





**About Zolo and Loop** 




 Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.
 



 People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.
 



 Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.
 



 Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.
 



 Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.
 



 Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.
 



**Loop by Zolo creates vibrant, community\-led stays for young travellers — bringing together comfortable accommodation, shared experiences, and spaces designed for connection.** 




 Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.
 



 Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation by partnering deeply with property owners who think long term.
 



  





**What you will be responsible for** 




**Drive Outreach \& Build Supply Pipeline** 



* Identify and reach out to property owners in assigned markets
* Build a consistent pipeline of potential Loop properties
* Generate new owner and property leads regularly
* Build local networks and identify potential supply opportunities
* Maintain strong meeting cadence across weeks
* Avoid pipeline gaps due to inconsistent outreach



**Identify \& Understand Potential Properties** 



* Understand the property, location, configuration, and owner expectations
* Gather relevant information required for initial property evaluation
* Understand whether the property broadly fits Loop’s business requirements
* Identify obvious gaps or concerns early in the conversation
* Ensure relevant property information is captured accurately
* Coordinate next steps for properties that qualify for further evaluation



**Run Structured Owner Conversations** 



* Understand the owner’s context, asset, expectations, and priorities before pitching
* Follow a clear conversation flow —
 **context → need → opportunity → solution**
* Explain the Loop proposition clearly and confidently
* Help owners understand how a partnership with Loop could work
* Avoid random or premature pitching
* Build credibility and trust through every interaction



**Capture Insights \& Objections** 



* Document owner feedback and objections accurately
* Understand what is preventing an owner from moving forward
* Identify common patterns across owner conversations
* Share market and owner insights with the team
* Maintain high\-quality information for reviews and coaching
* Convert field conversations into actionable learning



**Drive Follow\-ups \& Deal Movement** 



* Ensure timely and consistent follow\-ups for every opportunity
* Maintain clear next steps for all active leads
* Keep qualified properties moving through the supply funnel
* Coordinate site visits, discussions, documentation, and internal evaluation wherever required
* Prevent opportunities from becoming stagnant due to poor follow\-through
* Maintain ownership until there is a clear outcome



**Maintain CRM \& Process Discipline** 



* Update CRM after every meaningful interaction
* Maintain accurate property information and deal stages
* Ensure no opportunity is lost due to poor tracking
* Maintain clear visibility of next steps and timelines
* Follow defined BD processes and playbooks
* Enable clean pipeline reviews and forecasting



**Operate with High Energy in the Field** 



* Travel extensively across assigned locations for owner meetings and property visits
* Maintain consistency in effort across multiple conversations and meetings
* Be comfortable exploring new markets and identifying opportunities on ground
* Handle rejection without a drop in energy
* Stay proactive and responsive in owner interactions
* Demonstrate strong field hustle and ownership



  





**What success looks like after 6–12 months** 



* Consistent owner outreach and meeting cadence
* Strong pipeline of relevant properties across assigned markets
* Better qualification of properties before they move deeper into the funnel
* High\-quality and structured owner conversations
* Clean and reliable CRM data for reviews
* Consistent follow\-ups across active opportunities
* Steady movement of qualified properties through the supply funnel
* Strong understanding of assigned markets and owner dynamics
* High reliability — commitments consistently delivered



 The supply pipeline feels
 **active, relevant, structured, and consistently moving forward** 
 .
 



  





**Who this role is for** 




 You will likely thrive here if:
 


* You are comfortable spending significant time in the field
* You enjoy meeting property owners and building new relationships
* You are curious about properties, locations, and how businesses operate
* You can handle rejection and continue with high energy
* You are comfortable initiating conversations with people you have never met before
* You prefer structured execution over ad\-hoc working
* You are willing to learn and improve quickly
* You take ownership of your output and follow\-through
* You enjoy building something from the ground up



  





**Experience we value** 



* 0–2 years of experience in Business Development, Sales, Real Estate, Hospitality, Property Acquisition, or other customer\-facing roles
* Freshers with strong business development and field\-sales inclination may be considered
* Comfort with extensive travel and field work
* Strong communication skills and confidence in conversations
* Ability to build relationships with property owners
* Willingness to operate in a target\-driven environment



 Experience in
 **hostels, hospitality, real estate, co\-living, student housing, property brokerage, or supply acquisition** 
 will be an advantage but is not mandatory.
 



**Execution discipline, learning ability, relationship building, and field hustle are critical.** 




  





**The impact you will have** 



* You will directly build the supply pipeline that fuels Loop’s expansion
* You will help identify the properties that can become future Loop destinations
* You will shape how property owners perceive and engage with Loop
* You will create the foundation for owner partnerships and deal closures
* You will build market intelligence through your conversations on ground
* You will directly influence the speed and quality of Loop’s expansion



  





**Why join now** 




 Loop by Zolo is building a new\-age hospitality experience for young travellers across India.
 



 As Loop enters new markets, building the right property pipeline and strong owner partnerships will be fundamental to growth.
 



 This role offers early exposure to
 **hospitality, real estate, property acquisition, owner negotiations, and business expansion** 
 , with a clear performance\-driven growth path.
 



 You will not just be selling an existing product.
 



**You will help identify and build the properties that become the next Loop destinations.**

Working closely with the VP \- Sales and cross\-functional leaders, the role develops territory and account strategies, applies disciplined sales processes, maintains a high\-quality pipeline and forecast, and navigates multi\-stakeholder buying cycles from initial engagement through commercial negotiation and handover. The Senior Sales Executive brings strong market judgement, consultative and value\-selling capability, commercial acumen, and customer advocacy to strengthen client trust, expand strategic relationships, and consistently deliver revenue and margin objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Develop and execute territory, segment, and target\-account strategies aligned to India growth priorities, ideal customer profiles, and revenue objectives.
* Originate and qualify high\-value opportunities through executive networks, referrals, strategic partnerships, market intelligence, events, and focused outreach.
* Build trusted relationships with C\-suite, procurement, HR, talent, finance, and operational stakeholders, mapping influence, decision criteria, and buying dynamics.
* Own the full sales cycle for complex opportunities, from discovery and opportunity strategy through proposal, negotiation, contracting, and transition to delivery.
* Consistently achieve or exceed revenue, gross\-margin, new\-logo, pipeline coverage, and conversion objectives while protecting commercial quality.
* Represent HeadFirst Global as a credible market voice at senior client forums, industry events, and strategic networking platforms.



  





**Client Engagement \& Solutions:** 



* Lead executive\-level discovery to uncover strategic priorities, operational pain points, risk considerations, decision criteria, and measurable success outcomes.
* Apply consultative and value\-based selling methods to connect HeadFirst Global's capabilities with client outcomes, including productivity, compliance, scalability, experience, cost optimization, and speed to value.
* Orchestrate cross\-functional solution design with Sales, Customer Success, Talent Management, Finance, Legal, and Operations, ensuring propositions are differentiated, deliverable, and commercially sound.
* Develop and present compelling business cases, proposals, and executive presentations that articulate value, return on investment, commercial logic, and implementation confidence.
* Lead complex negotiations across scope, commercials, service levels, risk, and contract terms, maintaining client trust while protecting margin and governance standards.
* Act as a customer advocate by bringing client insight into solution development, mobilizing internal support, and setting clear expectations that enable long\-term value realisation



  





**Pipeline Management \& Reporting:** 



* Maintain rigorous CRM discipline, complete opportunity data, and clear next\-step ownership across all active accounts and deals.
* Build and manage a balanced, stage\-appropriate pipeline with sufficient coverage, prioritizing opportunities by strategic fit, value, probability, timing, and margin potential.
* Apply the agreed sales methodology and qualification framework consistently, using evidence\-based deal reviews to identify risks, remove blockers, and improve conversion.
* Provide accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasts, clearly articulating assumptions, dependencies, decision paths, and recovery actions.
* Use data, market intelligence, and AI\-enabled sales tools to improve account prioritization, research, outreach personalization, pipeline insight, and forecast quality while applying appropriate judgement and data safeguards.
* Provide actionable insight on market trends, competitors, buying behaviour, customer needs, and proposition gaps to inform commercial strategy and portfolio development.



  





**Governance \& Collaboration:** 



* Operate within the delegation of authority, pricing, margin, contractual, compliance, and ethical frameworks; escalate exceptions early and with clear recommendations.
* Lead internal deal governance for priority opportunities, aligning stakeholders on win strategy, solution, commercials, risks, approvals, and responsibilities.
* Coordinate a disciplined handover to Customer Success and delivery teams, ensuring commitments, assumptions, risks, success measures, and stakeholder expectations are documented and understood.
* Partner effectively across functions and geographies to mobilize expertise, remove barriers, and present one integrated HeadFirst Global experience to the client.
* Share winning practices, market insight, and constructive coaching with colleagues, contributing to continuous improvement in sales capability, process, and performance.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* Substantial B2B solution\-sales or business\-development experience, preferably in staffing, MSP, RPO, GCC, workforce solutions, technology\-enabled services, or professional services.
* Demonstrated record of winning new logos, meeting or exceeding revenue and margin targets, and closing complex, multi\-stakeholder opportunities.
* Strong proficiency in sales strategy, territory and account planning, consultative and value selling, opportunity qualification, commercial negotiation, and disciplined sales\-process execution.
* Advanced pipeline management and forecasting capability, with strong CRM discipline and the ability to convert data into practical deal and portfolio decisions.
* Credibility and confidence engaging C\-suite and senior functional leaders, with excellent executive communication, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
* Commercial acumen with the ability to develop business cases, articulate return on investment, understand pricing and margin implications, and balance customer value with organizational outcomes.
* AI fluency, including effective and responsible use of AI\-enabled tools for research, account intelligence, prospecting, personalization, proposal development, productivity, and sales analysis; able to validate outputs and protect confidential data.
* Strong customer\-advocacy orientation, with evidence of representing the customer voice internally, resolving barriers, and building relationships that support retention, expansion, and referrals.
* Sound understanding of the India commercial and workforce landscape, including relevant client buying dynamics, market trends, and regulatory considerations.
* High levels of ownership, resilience, judgement, collaboration, and adaptability in a fast\-growing, matrixed environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, or a related field; relevant advanced study or professional sales certification is advantageous.



  





**What We Offer:** 



* The opportunity to shape commercial growth across India's major metropolitan markets and represent a differentiated GCC and workforce solutions portfolio.
* A high\-impact senior individual\-contributor role with access to executive stakeholders, strategic opportunities, and international expertise.
* A collaborative, ambitious, and customer\-led culture that values performance, ownership, innovation, and responsible use of technology.
* Competitive compensation, performance\-based incentives, and clear opportunities for continued professional and leadership development.

title: Business Development Manager - Catering & Events
description:
CraftMyPlate is Hyderabad's go\-to platform for food experiences for micro\-events—house parties, birthdays, office celebrations, festive gatherings, and more. We are building the operating system for how India discovers, customises, and orders food for smaller events.
 



  





 Started in Hyderabad and backed by established founders and investors,
 **CraftMyPlate is a funded, fast\-growing startup working at the intersection of food, technology, and consumer experience** 
 . You will work closely with a sharp cross\-functional team across growth, product, operations, supply chain, and customer experience—and have a direct role in shaping how the business scales.
 



  





**Your Role** 




 This is not a conventional banquet\-sales or "quotation\-and\-follow\-up" role. We're looking for someone who has run the sales and the operational side of catering or banquets at scale—someone who knows what it takes to close a booking, and equally, what it takes to execute a flawless event on the ground. You'll bring that dual lens to CraftMyPlate as we scale beyond micro\-events into larger catering and corporate/community occasions, and help us become the default choice for every event in Hyderabad, big or small.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* Own high\-value and large\-scale catering conversations end\-to\-end—understanding occasion, guest count, budget, menu preferences, and timelines, and translating that into the right CraftMyPlate experience.
* Convert inbound and self\-sourced leads into confirmed bookings through sharp consultation, timely follow\-through, and confident closing—not just sending menus and waiting.
* Take ownership of execution readiness for larger events: coordinating with kitchen, catering ops, and on\-ground teams to make sure what's sold gets delivered without surprises.
* Build and manage a disciplined pipeline across corporate, community, RWA, and repeat/referral catering opportunities—no missed follow\-ups, no leads without context.
* Bring your hospitality and banquet background into the room—identify what corporate and large\-event clients actually expect, and push CraftMyPlate's offering to match and exceed those standards.
* Feed real customer and on\-ground insights back to founders, product, and ops teams—what large clients ask for, where deals stall, what makes an event succeed or fail operationally.
* Explore new channels for larger bookings: corporate tie\-ups, event planners, banquet/venue partnerships, and community networks.
* Own your numbers: pipeline value, conversion rate, average order value, repeat and referral rate, and revenue contribution from larger accounts.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Someone who has actually run banquet or large\-scale catering sales and operations—not someone who has only sold, or only executed, but someone who has done both and understands how the two connect.
* A person who is sharp and street\-smart in conversations, builds client trust quickly, and can read a room—whether it's a corporate client, an event planner, or a family hosting a large celebration.
* Someone who has outgrown the structure of a traditional hotel or banquet hall and is actively looking for a bigger, less bounded role with more ownership and faster growth.
* A strong sense of ownership—if a large event has a gap, a client has a concern, or an opportunity needs chasing, you take it to closure without waiting to be told.
* Someone comfortable with targets, ambiguity, and the pace of an early\-stage startup—this is a very different environment from a hotel banquet department, and we want someone who's ready for that shift, not intimidated by it.
* A person who wants to build a long\-term career in business, growth, or hospitality\-meets\-consumer\-tech, and sees this as a launchpad rather than a lateral move.



  





**Skills \& Requirements** 



* Minimum 3 years of experience in banquet sales, catering sales, hotel operations, or event/hospitality management, with clear exposure to both closing business and executing on\-ground.
* A degree in Hotel Management or Hospitality is required; prior experience working in hotels, banquet halls, or large catering operations is a must.
* Proven track record of handling large\-scale catering or banquet operations—guest counts, vendor coordination, event\-day execution—not just small or one\-off orders.
* Fluency in Telugu is mandatory for this role. Excellent spoken and written English \& Hindi are strong advantages.
* Comfortable speaking with clients over phone, WhatsApp, and in person, including site visits and on\-ground event coordination when required.
* Experience using a CRM or managing structured lead and event pipelines is preferred.
* Ability to read basic sales and ops data and sharpen your own performance through disciplined execution.
* Based in Hyderabad or willing to work from Hyderabad.



  





**What This Role Is Not** 



* It is not a traditional banquet\-hall or hotel sales role with fixed scripts, fixed packages, and slow\-moving approvals.
* It is not a role limited to sending menus and quotations and waiting for a client to decide.
* It is not suitable for someone who needs daily instructions to manage priorities, follow\-ups, or event execution.
* It is not a narrowly defined, hierarchy\-heavy corporate hospitality role.



  





 At CraftMyPlate, you will learn directly from people building a category\-defining company, work with talented teams across functions, and see a clear, fast connection between your work and the company's growth.

* Expanding Sii's presence across key industries, including banking and financial services, healthcare and life sciences, hi\-tech, automotive, industrial, retail, and other technology\-driven sectors

* Building and maintaining a strong sales pipeline while developing long\-term client relationships and identifying opportunities for continued account growth

* Proven track record of acquiring new clients, opening new accounts, and delivering measurable sales results

 Collected revenue from assigned schools, new signed schools, conversion of qualified opportunities, on time collections, renewals, account expansion and accurate CRM updates. Account lists, targets and review cadence are agreed at the start of the engagement.

**Employee**

**Independent consultant** 
  Works directly with the CEO on a defined school portfolio or territory with documented account attribution and agreed activities. Must be able to personally advance introductions through closing and payment follow up. Consultants cannot promise unapproved pricing or bind Lean Hyphen to terms.
 



  





**What we are looking for** 




 ·  Existing access to Hyderabad K–12 school decision makers and a record of personally converting school relationships into paid partnerships.
 



 ·  Experience selling education services, curriculum, assessments, publishing, STEM or school technology is valuable. Employees should generally bring 5 to 8 years of relevant institutional sales experience; consultants should show comparable deal outcomes.
 



 ·  Strong presentation, negotiation and follow through; ability to coordinate internal teams while keeping accountability for the school relationship.
 



 ·  Willingness to share verifiable examples of schools personally opened, contracts closed, collections followed up and renewals retained.
 



  





**How to apply** 





 State whether you are applying as an employee, a consultant, or open to both. Share your résumé or profile, Hyderabad school network, and two or three partnerships you personally won, including approximate contract value and your role through payment.  Interested candidates with relevant experience may share their

title: Sales Analyst
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company’s patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
   

  

 Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Sales Analyst is the operational and analytical backbone of the sales organization. The role owns the integrity of the lead and account data that the sales team runs on — reconciling leads from multiple sources, keeping the CRM accurate, ensuring accounts are allocated correctly across the sales team, and turning activity data into insight through tracking, analysis and dashboards. This is a hands\-on role for someone who is comfortable working with messy data across systems, has strong judgement about what “clean” looks like, and can use Python, Advanced Excel and AI tools such as Claude to move faster than a manual process would allow
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead Management and Reconciliation
* Consolidate and reconcile leads across the existing lead base and all new inbound and outbound sources, including membership rosters, conference and event lists, marketing campaigns, referrals and partner or purchased lists.
* Identify and resolve duplicates, near\-matches and conflicting records across sources; establish a single, trusted view of each lead and account.
* Standardise lead data (company name, domain, industry, geography, contact details, source attribution) so records are usable for segmentation and reporting. Incorporate lead qualifiers to improve sales strategy.
* Maintain a clear audit trail of what came in, from where, when, and how it was resolved.
* Flag data\-quality issues at source and work with marketing, events and membership teams to fix them upstream.
* CRM Ownership and Account Allocation
* Keep the CRM current and accurate for leads, contacts, accounts and opportunities; own bulk uploads, enrichment and clean\-up.
* Allocate accounts and leads across the sales team in line with the coverage model and territory or segment rules agreed with sales leadership.
* Track allocation coverage — identify unassigned, over\-concentrated or stale accounts and escalate for re\-allocation.
* Implement changes to ownership, territories and segmentation promptly and communicate them to affected sales team members.
* Maintain CRM hygiene standards, documentation and light process and field governance; train and support the sales team on correct usage.
* Sales Activity Tracking and Analysis
* Track leading indicators of sales performance — calls, meetings, discussions, follow\-ups, pipeline creation and conversion at each stage.
* Produce regular analysis on activity volumes, conversion rates, cycle times, source effectiveness and pipeline health, by representative, segment, region and lead source.
* Report on closed sales against targets and connect outcomes back to the activity and lead sources that generated them.
* Surface trends, bottlenecks and outliers proactively rather than only on request; provide the commentary that explains why the numbers moved, not just what they are.
* Support sales leadership with ad\-hoc analysis for pipeline reviews, forecasting discussions and planning cycles.
* Dashboards and Reporting Infrastructure
* Build and maintain dashboards that give sales leaders and representatives a live view of leads, activity, pipeline and performance against target.
* Automate recurring reporting so that manual effort is minimised and refresh cycles are reliable.
* Design reporting that is genuinely used — clear definitions, consistent metrics, and views tailored to each audience (representative, manager, leadership).
* Own the documentation of metric definitions and data sources so numbers are consistent across the organisation. 5\. Cross\-Functional Working
* Work closely with other functional teams as required — marketing, membership, events, finance, product and IT — to source data, resolve issues and support shared initiatives.
* Act as the point of contact for sales data requests from other functions, and ensure the numbers shared outside the team are consistent with internal reporting. Contribute to cross\-functional projects such as system migrations, campaign planning, event follow\-up and annual planning cycles.


**Required Skills And Experience**
**Technical**
* Python — data cleaning, deduplication, fuzzy and entity matching, joining data across sources, and automation of recurring tasks (pandas and similar libraries).
* Advanced Excel — complex formulas, lookups, Power Query, pivot tables, modelling and large\-file handling.
* AI tools — practical working experience with Claude or comparable AI agents and assistants to accelerate analysis, data preparation, reconciliation logic, documentation and reporting workflows.
* CRM — hands\-on experience administering or operating in a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Dynamics or similar), including imports, field management and reporting.
* Dashboarding — experience building dashboards in a BI tool (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) or native CRM reporting.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree.
* Preferably experience in sales operations, revenue operations, business analysis or a similar analytical role.


 By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Business Development Manager – UAV \& Robotics Propulsion Systems** 




**Full\-time \| On\-site (Non\-Hybrid)** 




**Vector Technics Pvt Ltd** 




 SY No 37/A, Plot No. 2\-12, Shamshabad, Rasheedguda, Hyderabad, Telangana 501218
 



  





 You don’t just close deals. You architect the kinetic backbone of the next generation of unmanned systems.
 



 At Vector Technics, we design and manufacture the complete electric propulsion stack — BLDC motors, ESCs, propellers, power electronics, and motion\-control solutions — with uncompromising vertical integration and a 100% indigenous, traceable supply chain. Our systems power mission\-critical UAVs, defense platforms, and advanced robotics across 12\+ countries. We are not chasing the future. We are building the precision that makes it possible.
 



 We are looking for a Business Development Manager who lives at the intersection of deep technical understanding and relentless commercial execution. Someone who can walk into a DRDO lab, a UAV integrator’s engineering review, or a robotics OEM’s strategy meeting and speak their language fluently — because you’ve lived it.
 


 The Role
 
 This is not a desk\-and\-dial job. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based at our advanced manufacturing and engineering facility in Shamshabad, Hyderabad. You will be immersed in the same ecosystem where our propulsion systems are conceived, refined, tested, and built. Real\-time collaboration with design, quality (AS9100\), and production teams is not optional — it is how we win.
 



 You will own the full business development lifecycle for our propulsion and motion\-control portfolio across UAV, defense, and robotics verticals:
 



 ●      Identify, qualify, and convert high\-value opportunities with UAV OEMs, defense primes, system integrators, and robotics companies — both in India and internationally.
 



 ●      Lead complex, technical sales cycles: RFP responses, custom solutioning, technical presentations, and contract negotiations.
 



 ●      Build and nurture long\-term strategic partnerships rather than transactional orders. You will become the trusted advisor who understands not just thrust and KV ratings, but the mission parameters, environmental stresses, and supply\-chain security requirements that actually matter.
 



 ●      Represent Vector Technics at key industry platforms — trade shows, technical working groups, and customer sites — translating field intelligence back into product and process improvements.
 



 ●      Maintain rigorous pipeline discipline, accurate forecasting, and CRM hygiene while working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with leadership on strategic account planning.
 



 ●      Champion indigenous capability. You will articulate why a fully traceable, NDAA\-aligned, Made\-in\-India propulsion solution is not just compliant — it is strategically superior.
 


 Who Thrives Here
 
 You are not a generic “sales guy.” You are a domain\-fluent builder with:
 



 ●      5–8\+ years of proven B2B business development or strategic sales experience selling UAV/drone components, robotics motion systems, aerospace actuators, or mission\-critical power electronics.
 



 ●      Demonstrated success navigating long\-cycle, technical, and often multi\-stakeholder deals in defense, aerospace, or advanced robotics.
 



 ●      Strong technical acumen — you can comfortably discuss motor constants, ESC firmware behavior, thermal management, propeller dynamics, and system\-level integration trade\-offs.
 



 ●      Existing relationships or credible access within the Indian UAV ecosystem, defense procurement landscape, or global robotics integrators (a significant advantage).
 



 ●      Comfort with ambiguity, ownership of outcomes, and the ability to operate with minimal hand\-holding in a high\-growth, high\-standards environment.
 



 ●      Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.
 



 Engineering background (Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, or Mechatronics) is strongly preferred. Experience with AS9100/ISO environments, government tenders, or export\-controlled technologies is a plus.
 


 The Culture You’re Joining
 
 We are a team of engineers, makers, and operators who believe that precision is a moral responsibility when lives and national capability depend on it. Titles are secondary to impact. Feedback flows freely because truth travels faster than hierarchy. We celebrate people who spot problems early, own them completely, and drive elegant solutions — whether on the shop floor or in a customer war\-room.
 



 You will work directly with leadership that still gets their hands dirty on drawings, test data, and supplier development. You will see your wins translated into real hardware flying in the field within months, not years. And you will be part of an organization that treats supply\-chain sovereignty not as a slogan, but as the foundation of credible deterrence and technological independence.

title: Growth Specialist
description:
Growth Specialist — Sales \& Partnerships
 



 Location: Hyderabad
 



 Employment type: Full\-time
 



 Experience: Exceptional final\-year students, recent graduates and early\-career candidates are welcome to apply.
 



 About Nextrap
 



 Nextrap is an analytics\-focused wearable and health technology company being built for India. Our first product combines a screenless smart band with a companion app that helps people understand sleep, recovery, activity, heart\-rate trends and the choices that shape their health.
 



 We are not looking to build just another gadget. We want to make health data genuinely useful, beautiful and actionable.
 



 The role
 



 This is not a narrow sales role and it is not a conventional marketing internship. You will be Nextrap’s first employee, working directly with the founder to help take an early wearable brand from product to real customer love, partnerships and revenue.
 



 You will speak to customers, sell the product, build early partnerships, run growth experiments, create sharp content, and bring back the honest insights that improve the product and brand.
 



 What you will own
 


* Turn early interest into sales through thoughtful outreach, product demos, follow\-ups and customer conversations.
* Build relationships with gyms, sports clubs, coaches, athletes, wellness communities, creators and relevant B2B partners.
* Represent Nextrap at events, activations and in\-person meetings.
* Run practical growth experiments across social media, WhatsApp, communities, partnerships and offline channels.
* Help shape customer\-facing messaging, sales collateral and product demos.
* Maintain a clean lead pipeline and clearly report what customers are asking for.
* Collect customer feedback and turn it into useful product and positioning insights.
* Take ownership of the work needed to move an early\-stage company forward.



 You may be a great fit if you
 


* Communicate with clarity, energy and empathy.
* Can confidently sell both a physical product and a software experience.
* Are proactive and follow through without needing every step defined.
* Care about fitness, health, technology, design or consumer brands.
* Are comfortable with rejection, ambiguity and fast iteration.
* Can write crisp messages, make a good presentation and hold an engaging product conversation.



 We would especially love to hear from people who actively
 **play sports** 
 or have competed at a high level. First\-hand experience of training, recovery and performance gives you a real advantage in understanding the product, discovering useful insights and speaking credibly with our early customers. This is a preference, not a requirement.
 



 Prior startup, consumer\-tech, fitness, sports, campus\-community, retail, sales, creator or partnership experience is useful, but not mandatory. We care more about hunger, judgment, communication and ownership than a perfect résumé.
 



 How to apply
 



 Send your résumé and a short note answering: How would you convince a health\-conscious Indian customer to try a screenless smart band from a new brand?
 



 Also share:
 


* One example of something you have sold, grown, organised or built—at college, work or independently.
* Your sport or fitness background, if applicable, and one health or performance insight you would want a wearable to help you understand.
* One piece of honest advice you would give Nextrap as an early\-stage wearable brand.

description:

**Company:** 
 Right Way Skill
 



**Engagement Type:**

**Location:** 
 Remote / Hybrid
 



**Start Date:** 
 Immediate
 



  




 About Right Way Skill
 
**Right Way Skill** 
 is a practical, career\-focused learning company helping people build real\-world skills for today's digital economy.
 



 Our approach is simple:
 



**Learn → Apply → Practise → Assess → Improve → Grow** 




 We focus on practical learning, hands\-on execution, industry\-relevant skills, and helping learners build the capabilities needed to grow their careers.
 



 As we scale Right Way Skill, we are looking for a
 **Strategic Investment Co\-Founder** 
 to join the founding team and help build the next stage of the company.
 



  




 The Opportunity
 
 This is
 **not a salaried position and not a passive investment opportunity.** 




 We are looking for a genuine
 **Co\-Founder who is willing to invest capital into Right Way Skill** 
 and actively participate in building and growing the business.
 



 The ideal partner will bring a combination of:
 


* **Financial investment**
* Sales and business development expertise
* Strategic business thinking
* Industry connections
* Customer acquisition capabilities
* Leadership and execution



 The co\-founder will work directly with the existing founding team to build a scalable education business and expand Right Way Skill's reach.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Make a strategic financial investment into Right Way Skill
* Take an active role as a member of the founding team
* Lead and develop the sales and business growth strategy
* Build a scalable customer acquisition and GTM strategy
* Generate and close high\-value opportunities
* Develop partnerships with companies, professionals, communities, institutions, and other relevant organizations
* Build and manage sales and business development processes
* Identify new markets and growth opportunities
* Help recruit and lead the sales team as the company scales
* Participate in strategic business decisions
* Build strong commercial partnerships
* Help establish predictable and scalable revenue


 Who We're Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who thinks like an
 **investor \+ entrepreneur \+ business builder** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate will have:
 


* 4–8\+ years of experience in sales, business development, entrepreneurship, revenue, or commercial leadership
* Strong experience in B2B/B2C sales and business growth
* Proven ability to generate and close business
* Strong professional and business network
* Experience with education, EdTech, training, digital services, SaaS, or other scalable businesses is a plus
* Strong negotiation and communication skills
* Entrepreneurial and ownership mindset
* **Ability and willingness to invest capital into Right Way Skill**
* Willingness to actively work with the founding team
* Long\-term commitment to building the company


 What You Get
 * **Co\-Founder position at Right Way Skill**
* Equity and/or profit\-sharing based on the agreed founder structure
* Ownership and influence over business growth
* Opportunity to participate in major strategic decisions
* Direct involvement in sales, partnerships, GTM, and expansion
* Opportunity to build long\-term value through the growth of Right Way Skill

 Investment \& Founder Structure
 
 The selected co\-founder will be required to make a
 **financial investment into Right Way Skill** 
 .
 



 The investment amount, equity percentage, profit\-sharing arrangement, responsibilities, and founder terms will be discussed and mutually agreed upon based on the overall partnership structure.
 



 We are looking for a partner who contributes
 **both capital and active involvement** 
 .
 


 This is not for:
 * Passive investors
* People looking for a salaried job
* People looking only for an advisory role

 This is for someone who wants to:
 
**Invest → Build → Grow → Own** 




 If you have the capital, business experience, sales capability, and entrepreneurial mindset to build Right Way Skill alongside the founding team, we would like to hear from you.

title: Business Development Intern
description:
**Company:** 
 Fuworx Innovations Pvt Ltd
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India (Hybrid / Work From Office)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Internship
 



**Duration** 
 : 3 Months
 



  





**About Fuworx Innovations Pvt Ltd** 




  





 Fuworx Innovations Pvt Ltd is a digital transformation and business services company helping organizations modernize their operations, improve customer experiences, and achieve scalable growth through technology\-driven solutions.
 



  





 We work with businesses across industries, delivering solutions across digital engineering, enterprise applications, automation, cloud, AI, and business services.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for a proactive and enthusiastic Business Development Intern to join our growing sales and business development team.
 



  





 The intern will support the complete B2B business development process, including prospect identification, lead generation, cold outreach, client communication, follow\-ups, meeting coordination, and sales pipeline management.
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who wants to build a career in Business Development, B2B Sales, IT Sales, or Client Acquisition.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 \* Research and identify potential B2B clients across target industries and markets.
 



 \* Generate new business leads through LinkedIn, email, cold calling, online research, and other channels.
 



 \* Understand prospects' business requirements and identify potential opportunities for Fuworx solutions.
 



 \* Conduct initial outreach to prospective clients through calls, emails, and LinkedIn.
 



 \* Qualify leads based on business requirements, budget, decision\-making authority, and potential fit.
 



 \* Maintain and regularly update lead databases, prospect information, and CRM records.
 



 \* Follow up with prospects through calls, emails, and LinkedIn to move leads through the sales pipeline.
 



 \* Schedule meetings and product/service discussions between qualified prospects and the senior sales team.
 



 \* Assist in preparing sales presentations, company profiles, proposals, pitch decks, and introductory documents.
 



 \* Support the sales team in preparing for client meetings and follow\-up activities.
 



 \* Track daily outreach, responses, meetings, follow\-ups, and lead conversion activities.
 



 \* Monitor competitor activities, industry trends, and potential business opportunities.
 



 \* Work closely with the sales and marketing teams to improve lead\-generation strategies.
 



 \* Achieve assigned daily and weekly targets for calls, emails, LinkedIn outreach, leads, and meetings.
 



  





**Requirements** 




  





 \* Currently pursuing or recently completed MBA / BBA / Business / Marketing / Commerce or a related field.
 



 \* Strong interest in Business Development, B2B Sales, IT Sales, and Client Acquisition.
 



 \* Good verbal and written communication skills.
 



 \* Comfortable making cold calls and communicating with potential clients.
 



 \* Basic knowledge of LinkedIn, email outreach, lead generation, and online research.
 



 \* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
 



 \* Ability to research companies, identify decision\-makers, and collect relevant prospect information.
 



 \* Self\-motivated, target\-oriented, and willing to learn.
 



 \* Ability to work independently as well as with a team.
 



 \* Positive attitude with strong follow\-up and relationship\-building skills.
 



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  





 \* Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator or similar prospecting tools.
 



 \* Basic understanding of CRM systems.
 



 \* Knowledge of IT services, software solutions, digital transformation, or technology sales is an advantage.
 



 \* Previous experience in sales, business development, telecalling, or lead generation is a plus, but freshers are welcome.
 



  





**What You Will Gain** 




  





 \* Hands\-on experience in B2B business development and IT sales.
 



 \* Practical exposure to the complete sales cycle, from prospecting to meeting generation.
 



 \* Experience working with LinkedIn, email campaigns, CRM, lead\-generation tools, and sales databases.
 



 \* Exposure to client communication and business requirements.
 



 \* Opportunity to work closely with experienced sales and business leaders.
 



 \* Understanding of how technology and digital transformation solutions are sold to businesses.
 



 \* Professional mentorship and career development opportunities.
 



  





**Stipend \& Benefits** 




  





 \* Internship stipend based on company policy and performance.
 



 \* Internship Certificate.
 



 \* Letter of Recommendation based on performance.
 



 \* Performance\-based incentives may be provided.
 



 \* Potential full\-time employment opportunity based on performance and business requirements.
 



 \* Opportunity to build a career in Business Development / B2B Sales / IT Sales.

title: Sales Leader
description:
**Job Description:** 

 SatelliteHR is a new HRMS venture built to bring a modern, workforce\-first product to market. We are looking for a Sales Leader to own the sales function from the ground up: define the go\-to\-market strategy, build and lead the sales team, and take personal ownership of early revenue while the function is still being established.
 



 ‍
 



 This is a founding sales leadership role, not an individual\-contributor position. The right candidate has already carried a quota, has since built or led a sales team, and is ready to do both again at the same time: sell personally in the early stage while designing the process, hiring the team, and reporting directly to the founders on strategy and results.
 



 ‍
 



 The ideal candidate combines direct HRMS, HCM, Payroll, or HR\-Tech sales experience with a track record of building a sales function or team from an early stage, strong consultative selling instincts with CHROs, CFOs, and founders, and the judgment to operate with significant autonomy in a founder\-led environment.
 



 ‍
 


**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 

  




**Sales Strategy and Go\-to\-Market Ownership** 
* Define and own the sales strategy for SatelliteHR, including target segments, pricing approach, and channel mix.
* Build the sales playbook, pipeline stages, and qualification criteria from the ground up.
* Set and own monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets, and report progress directly to the founders.
* Identify and prioritize industry verticals and territories for early market entry, including GCC and other target markets.



  




**Team Building and Leadership** 
* Hire, train, and lead the first sales and business development hires as the function scales beyond the founding stage.
* Build a repeatable onboarding and coaching approach so the team can scale without the Head of Sales personally closing every deal.
* Set individual and team quotas and hold the team accountable to them.



  




**Direct Sales Ownership (Early Stage)** 
* Personally own and close early deals while the team is being built, from prospecting through contract closure.
* Conduct discovery conversations with HR and business leaders to understand workforce challenges and map them to the product.
* Lead commercial discussions, pricing negotiations, and contract closures for strategic accounts.
* Ensure a smooth handover of signed customers to implementation and customer success.



  




**Consultative Solution Selling** 
* Position the HRMS platform as a strategic business solution across HR operations, payroll, attendance, leave management, recruitment, performance management, and employee engagement.
* Act as a trusted advisor to CHROs, HR heads, business heads, founders, and CFOs.
* Build strong, ROI\-driven business cases tailored to each buyer.



  




**Stakeholder Management** 
* Build and maintain relationships with CHROs, HR heads, CEOs, CFOs, founders, and operations heads at target accounts.
* Navigate complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders and influencers.
* Drive consensus and accelerate decision\-making within client organizations.



  




**Market Intelligence and Competitive Positioning** 
* Track HR technology trends, workforce management challenges, and competitor offerings, and translate them into positioning and messaging.
* Feed market insight and customer feedback back into product and founder\-level strategy discussions.



  




**Partnership and Channel Development** 
* Develop relationships with HR consultants, implementation partners, payroll partners, and industry associations.
* Build channel partnerships that extend market reach without requiring a proportional increase in headcount.



  




**Sales Operations and Governance** 
* Stand up and maintain CRM discipline, pipeline reporting, and forecasting from the earliest stage of the company.
* Provide regular pipeline and revenue updates directly to the founders.



  




**Work Experience and Skills:** 
* Proven experience in HRMS, Payroll, HCM, HR Tech, ERP, or SaaS sales, including direct, personal deal ownership.
* Demonstrated experience building or leading a sales team, ideally from an early or founding stage.
* Track record of building a market or sales function from the ground up (0\-to\-1 experience), not only scaling an established one.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and workforce management challenges.
* Excellent consultative and solution\-selling skills, with the ability to sell personally as well as lead others to do so.
* Strong negotiation and commercial acumen.
* Ability to influence senior executives, founders, and business leaders.
* Comfort operating with high autonomy and direct founder\-level accountability, without a fully built\-out organization around the role.
* Hands\-on experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, or similar platforms.



  




**Minimum Qualifications:** 
* At least 2 to 3 years in a role that included building, leading, or mentoring a sales or business development team.
* Demonstrated ability to meet and exceed sales targets.
* Experience in startup environments or service\-based businesses is highly desirable.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Human Resources, Information Technology, or a related discipline.



  




**What’s in it for you?** 

  




**Professional Growth \& Impact** 
* The opportunity to build a sales function and team from the ground up at a founding\-stage company, with direct visibility to the founders.
* Ownership of go\-to\-market strategy, not just execution against a plan set by someone else.
* A fast growth path tied to the growth of the company itself, with career coaching and mentorship along the way.



  




**Work Environment \& Culture** 
* Innovative Team: Collaborate with passionate professionals in a fast\-paced, agile environment.
* Autonomy \& Ownership: Take full ownership of your sales pipeline and strategy.
* Mission\-Driven Work: Help startups thrive by solving real operational challenges.



  




**Employee Benefits** 
* Competitive Compensation: Attractive base salary with performance\-based incentives.
* Health \& Wellness: Medical insurance.
* Paid Time Off: Generous leave policy including vacation, and holidays.
* Retirement Benefits: PF, and Gratuity.
* Employee Engagement: Regular team events, recognition programs, and a collaborative culture that values your contributions.

title: Senior B2C Sales Lead
description:
**We are looking for a Senior Sales Lead to own and drive our consumer (B2C) sales engine, build high\-value partnerships, and lead a team of empathetic, values\-driven salespeople. This is a key role for someone who can combine strong business ownership with people leadership, and who believes that sustainable growth and integrity aren’t mutually exclusive.
 



  





 About PMX Health \-
 



 We are India’s first healthcare company focused on longevity and personalized medicine. We help people prevent or manage chronic conditions and optimize their health through a holistic approach. Through our user\-friendly tech platform, we offer cutting\-edge diagnostics, functional nutrition consultations, AI\-powered personalized plans, and continuous monitoring.
 



  





 You Should Be/Have \-
 



  





 \- 10\+ years of overall experience in B2C sales, with at least 4\+ years in a sales management/leadership role
 



 \- A strong sense of ownership over business goals — someone who treats targets as their own, not just numbers assigned to them
 



 \- Proven ability to build and nurture partnerships that translate into consistent, month\-on\-month business growth
 



 \- A natural coach and guide who can lead a team, not just manage one — someone the team wants to maximize their potential for
 



 \- Empathetic and values\-first in approach — we’re not looking for a typical “hard\-sell” sales culture.
 



 \- We want someone who can bring in strong business without compromising on values, and who uplifts their team along the way
 



 \- Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced healthcare/wellness environment, balancing revenue goals with the sensitivity our members and their health journeys deserve
 



  





 What You’ll Do \-
 



 \- Own the end\-to\-end B2C sales function and be directly accountable for business goals and revenue targets
 



 \- Identify, build, and manage partnerships that create sustainable, month\-on\-month business pipelines
 



 \- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of sales professionals — setting the tone for a culture that is empathetic, ethical, and high\-performing
 



 \- Build and refine sales processes, playbooks, and pitch approaches suited to a consultative, trust\-driven healthcare sale
 



 \- Work closely with the marketing and clinical teams to align sales efforts with lead generation, campaigns, and product launches
 



 \- Track team and individual performance, coach for improvement, and ensure the team is set up to consistently exceed goals
 



 \- Represent PMX Health’s values in every customer and partner interaction, ensuring growth never comes at the cost of trust
 



  





 Why PMX Health?
 



 \- Be part of a pioneering team at the forefront of personalized nutrition and preventive healthcare
 



 \- Work in a supportive and collaborative environment that fosters professional growth
 



 \- Family discounts on PMX longevity plans**

title: Business Development Manager cum Patient Counsellor
description:
**Company Description** 
 Akruti Plastic \& Cosmetic Surgery Centre is a leading clinic in Hyderabad specializing in advanced aesthetic, reconstructive, and corrective procedures with a strong patient\-first focus. The centre combines modern surgical techniques, ethical medical practices, and personalized care to deliver safe, natural\-looking, confidence\-enhancing results. Services include cosmetic surgery, reconstructive procedures, hair transplantation, body contouring, facial aesthetics, and breast surgeries, supported by experienced plastic surgeons and a dedicated clinical team. Akruti emphasizes precision, transparency, and long\-term well\-being throughout the patient journey, from initial consultation to recovery. The clinic operates from Kukatpally and Kondapur in Hyderabad, with consultations available by appointment.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Business Development Manager cum Patient Counsellor role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Hyderabad, working across Akruti’s centres. This role involves identifying and developing new business opportunities, building relationships with referring physicians and partners, and contributing to marketing and outreach initiatives to increase patient footfall. The position also entails counselling prospective and existing patients, explaining treatment options, procedures, costs, and post\-operative care in a clear and empathetic manner. Daily responsibilities include managing inquiries, coordinating consultations, maintaining accurate patient records, and ensuring a smooth experience from first contact through follow\-up. The role requires close collaboration with surgeons, clinical staff, and administrative teams to align business growth with high\-quality, ethical patient care.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and patient counselling skills, with the ability to explain medical procedures in simple, reassuring language.
* Business development and relationship management skills, including lead generation, networking, and maintaining professional partnerships.
* Basic marketing and customer engagement skills, such as supporting promotional campaigns, managing patient inquiries, and enhancing clinic visibility.
* Organizational and administrative abilities, including appointment coordination, documentation, and follow\-up management.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Management, Psychology, or a related field; relevant experience in healthcare or aesthetic services is an advantage.
* Comfort working in a clinical environment, with high standards of ethics, confidentiality, and patient\-centric service.
* Proficiency in English and local languages (such as Telugu and Hindi) preferred; ability to work flexible hours as per clinic needs.

**Primary KPI**

 **Team Demos:**

 • Hiring \& Onboarding Turnaround

**Key Competencies:**

 • Performance Evaluation

 • Hands\-on CRM Ownership
 



 • Horizontal Collaboration

 Bachelor's Degree in any discipline; MBA is a plus, not mandatory.

 4–7 years in Inside Sales, Consultative Sales, SaaS Demo Sales, Premium Real Estate or Luxury Retail, including at least 1–2 years mentoring or leading a team.
 



**Languages:** 
 Excellent verbal communication in English, Hindi, and Telugu is mandatory; an additional regional language is a plus.

 Proven history of hitting demo or meeting\-conversion targets personally, and coaching others to do the same.
 



**Hands\-on Tools:** 
 Direct, hands\-on experience configuring and using CRM platforms — not just logging into one.
 



 People Ownership: Has hired at least one team member and run a documented performance evaluation cycle.
 



  





**Keus Culture:** 




 Join a team that is passionate about innovation and excellence. At Keus, we value creativity, collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to leading the smart home revolution.

 To make playing football as easy as going for a jog.

 A world where playing football is as popular and accessible as watching football.

 We'd love to hear from you.
