title: Sr Adv Appl/Sys Sales Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, consultants, contractors, and internal sales teams across mission\-critical environments like Data Centers.
* Drive consultative selling by translating business needs, operational risks, and technical requirements into integrated Honeywell Building Automation solutions.
* Influence specifications and solution architecture for Security and Fire systems, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter protection systems, identity\-driven workflows, integrations and applications, and related mission\-critical infrastructure systems.
* Support account teams in identifying, qualifying, and advancing strategic opportunities in mission\-critical environments like Data Centers by developing compelling technical value propositions.
* Collaborate with sales, product, engineering, estimation, and operations teams to develop technically sound, commercially viable, and customer\-centric proposals.
* Lead customer workshops, technical presentations, and consultant engagements as a Honeywell subject matter expert.
* Develop and deliver technical demonstrations, proof of concepts, pilot deployments, solution validations, and customer enablement sessions aligned with security use cases and operational needs.


**Responsibilities**
**Technical Solutioning for Mission\-Critical Environments**
* Develop integrated Security and Fire solution concepts for mission\-critical infrastructure, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter protection systems, command center integration, emergency communication, and integrated security management platforms.
* Apply domain knowledge of Security and Fire to create scalable, resilient, and maintainable architectures covering physical access control, cards, readers, controllers, supervisory platforms, CCTV and video management systems, IP cameras, NVRs, perimeter protection systems, intercom, emergency communication, and integrated security management platforms.
* Design security architectures that address zoning, credentialing strategy, camera coverage, recording and retention requirements, alarm prioritization, operator workflows, redundancy, cybersecurity readiness, and integration with building management and fire life safety systems.
* Define integration approaches across third\-party systems using relevant protocols, APIs, SDKs, middleware, databases, and IP networking fundamentals such as TCP/IP, routing, VLANs, PoE, ONVIF, Wiegand, OSDP, and RTSP.
* Support customers and consultants in defining operational security outcomes such as controlled access, incident response, auditability, situational awareness, regulatory alignment, business continuity, and lifecycle serviceability.
* Review customer specifications, drawings, sequence of operations, and tender documents to identify solution gaps, risks, optimization opportunities, and Honeywell differentiators.
* Define solution scope, system architecture, bill of materials guidance, integration approach, and technical assumptions for complex proposals in mission\-critical environments like Data Centers.
* Advise customers on operational outcomes such as uptime, redundancy, energy optimization, alarm management, fault detection, cybersecurity readiness, and lifecycle serviceability.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Building Automation, or a related technical field.
* 12\+ years of experience in application engineering, systems sales engineering, solution consulting, pre\-sales, or technical solutioning for building automation, mission\-critical environments like Data Centers, industrial controls, or critical infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of Security and Fire systems, including access control systems, cards, readers, controllers, supervisory platforms, CCTV and video management platforms, IP cameras, NVRs, perimeter protection systems, command center operations, emergency communication, alarm management, system interoperability, and security integration architectures.
* Hands\-on understanding of security system design, deployment, commissioning, diagnostics, troubleshooting, product validation, and integration with enterprise integrations and applications.
* Experience reviewing technical specifications, designing solution architectures, supporting proposals, and influencing consultant or customer specifications.
* Proven ability to engage with end users, consultants, contractors, OEMs, and internal stakeholders in complex technical sales cycles.
* Willingness to travel for customer engagements, consultant meetings, site visits, workshops, and industry events.


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

 Process Improvement \& Reporting

* Identify bottlenecks and recurring operational issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive automation and effective utilization of CRM, HRMS, dashboards, and other digital tools.

* Analyze operational and sales data and recommend improvements to increase productivity, conversion, customer satisfaction, revenue, and profitability.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, approval processes, quality standards, and internal procedures.


 Leadership Support

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Deloitte USI \- Sales \- Business Research \& Insights Specialist Assistant Manager \| Hyderabad**
**About The Team**
 Deloitte Consulting Servicesworks globally across practices and borders to support Deloitte’s Strategy, Risk \& Transactions (SR\&T) and Technology \& Transformation (T\&T) businesses. The team is focused on offerings our clients and people the global experience that’s essential in today’s world. Leveraging leading\-edge tools, methods, and resources, we deliver top\-notch service that is applied locally while staying true to our global brand and core values.
   

  

 Within the Consulting Services, the Global Sales team is tasked with ensuring consistency in sales practices, sharing best practices, and enhancing win rates on a global scale. Collaborating closely with designated Global Sales Leaders from various geographies and business units, the team is committed to executing strategic priorities that are typically high\-impact and high\-visibility, aligning with the overarching strategic objectives of the firm.
   

  

 We are looking for a dynamic and motivated individual who thrives in both individual contributor as well as collaborative environments across different project magnitudes.
   

  

**Overview Of The Role**
 We are looking for a high\-energy, self\-motivated professional who can work with increasing independence, bring structure to ambiguity, and translate complex information into clear insights that support commercial decision\-making.
   

  

**Work you’ll do**
 The professional will lead insight and analysis initiatives that combine qualitative and quantitative information to identify meaningful themes, develop executive\-ready reporting, and provide recommendations that support sales effectiveness and business priorities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Mentor junior team members in qualitative analysis, evidence\-based insight development, and the preparation of executive\-ready deliverables.
* Identify opportunities to enhance analytical methodologies, reporting processes, tools, and knowledge\-sharing practices to improve insight quality, efficiency, and business impact.


**Requisite Core Skills**
* Strong qualitative synthesis skills, with the ability to convert ambiguous and unstructured inputs into clear themes, findings, and business implications.

We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. **Benefits**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits.
   

  

**Deloitte’s Culture**

We offer well\-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives.
   

  

**Corporate Citizenship**
 Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people, and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill\-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities.

title: Sales Executive | Full Time
description:
Sales Executive — Part\-Time, Hybrid
   

  

 Location: Kukatpalli, Hyderabad
   

 Work Type: Part\-Time \| Hybrid / On\-Site
   

 Industry: EdTech \| Digital Marketing \| Career Education
   

 Experience: 1–2 years preferred; freshers with strong communication and sales ability can apply
   

  

**About ZapScholar**
 ZapScholar is a digital learning platform focused on building practical, job\-ready digital marketing skills.
   

  

 Instead of relying only on classroom theory, ZapScholar focuses on hands\-on learning, real\-world projects, business challenges, and practical industry exposure. Our programs are designed to help learners develop skills they can apply directly in startups, businesses, agencies, and modern marketing teams.
   

  

 We are building a learning environment for people who want to learn by doing, build real skills, and become valuable in the workplace.
   

  

**About the Role**
 We are looking for a Sales Executive who can take ownership of the learner enrollment journey—from the first conversation with a prospective learner to final enrollment.
   

  

 You will speak with students, graduates, working professionals, and aspiring entrepreneurs who are interested in digital marketing and career growth. Your responsibility will be to understand their goals, explain the right ZapScholar program, handle questions and objections, conduct follow\-ups, and convert qualified prospects into enrolled learners.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on sales role, not just a calling position.
   

  

 You will work closely with the Marketing and Training teams to understand lead quality, learner requirements, objections, and market demand, and help improve the overall learner acquisition process.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 1\. Lead Management \& Prospecting
   

  

 \- Contact and qualify leads generated through marketing campaigns, referrals, events, and other channels.
   

 \- Understand each prospect’s career goals, experience, interests, and learning requirements.
   

 \- Maintain an organized pipeline of prospective learners.
   

 \- Identify high\-intent prospects and prioritize follow\-ups accordingly.
   

  

 2\. Sales \& Conversions
   

  

 \- Conduct sales calls and consultations with prospective learners.
   

 \- Clearly explain ZapScholar's programs, learning methodology, projects, outcomes, and value proposition.
   

 \- Conduct online or in\-person program demonstrations and counseling sessions.
   

 \- Handle questions, concerns, and objections professionally.
   

 \- Follow up consistently with interested prospects and move them through the enrollment funnel.
   

 \- Convert qualified prospects into paid enrollments while maintaining a consultative approach.
   

  

 3\. Learner Counseling
   

  

 \- Understand what the learner is trying to achieve before recommending a program.
   

 \- Help prospects evaluate whether ZapScholar is the right fit for their goals.
   

 \- Provide accurate information about programs, schedules, fees, learning structure, and enrollment process.
   

 \- Ensure that learners enter the program with clear expectations.
   

  

 4\. CRM \& Reporting
   

  

 \- Maintain accurate lead and prospect records in the CRM or designated sales\-tracking system.
   

 \- Track calls, follow\-ups, meetings, objections, conversions, and lead status.
   

 \- Provide regular updates on pipeline, conversions, and pending opportunities.
   

 \- Maintain disciplined follow\-up schedules.
   

  

 5\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

 \- Work with the Marketing team to improve lead quality and campaign performance.
   

 \- Share recurring objections, learner questions, and market feedback.
   

 \- Coordinate with the Training team when prospects require deeper information about the learning experience.
   

 \- Contribute ideas to improve the sales and enrollment process.
   

  

**Key Performance Areas**
 Success in this role will be measured through:
   

  

 \- Qualified leads contacted
   

 \- Calls and consultations conducted
   

 \- Follow\-up completion
   

 \- Lead\-to\-enrollment conversion rate
   

 \- Number of enrollments
   

 \- Revenue generated
   

 \- Pipeline management and CRM discipline
   

 \- Learner experience and quality of counseling
   

  

**Who We're Looking For**
 We are looking for someone who is:
   

  

 \- Confident and comfortable speaking with new people.
   

 \- Persuasive without being overly aggressive.
   

 \- Strong at listening, understanding needs, and explaining solutions.
   

 \- Comfortable making sales calls and following up repeatedly.
   

 \- Organized enough to manage multiple prospects simultaneously.
   

 \- Target\-oriented and motivated by measurable results.
   

 \- Interested in digital marketing, startups, business, sales, or education.
   

 \- Comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.
   

 \- Willing to learn, experiment, and improve their sales approach.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Required** 
 :
   

  

 \- Strong verbal communication skills.
   

 \- 1\-2 years of experience
   

 \- Basic sales and negotiation ability.
   

 \- Ability to conduct prospecting, follow\-ups, and sales conversations.
   

 \- Basic understanding of digital marketing or willingness to learn.
   

 \- Ability to work from our Kukatpalli location as required.
   

 \- Basic computer skills and familiarity with Google Workspace or similar tools.
   

  

**Preferred** 
 :
   

  

 \- 1–2 years of experience in sales, inside sales, business development, education counseling, admissions, or customer\-facing roles.
   

 \- Experience using a CRM or lead\-tracking system.
   

 \- Previous experience selling courses, education, SaaS, services, or other consultative products.
   

 \- Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
   

  

 Freshers: Candidates without prior sales experience can apply if they demonstrate strong communication, confidence, learning ability, and a genuine interest in sales.
   

  

 What You'll Get
   

  

 \- Hands\-on experience in EdTech, digital marketing, and startup sales.
   

 \- Opportunity to work directly with the founding and growth team.
   

 \- Exposure to the complete learner acquisition and sales funnel.
   

 \- Practical experience with lead generation, sales calls, CRM, conversions, and customer psychology.
   

 \- Performance\-based growth opportunities.
   

 \- Opportunity to develop into a larger sales, business development, or growth role based on performance.
   

  

 Important
   

  

 This role is best suited for someone who enjoys talking to people, understanding their problems, selling a valuable solution, and being accountable for results.
   

  

 If you are looking for a role where you simply make calls from a script, this may not be the right position.
   

  

 If you want to learn real startup sales while helping people build practical digital marketing careers, we'd like to hear from you.
   

  

 Apply for the Sales Executive role at ZapScholar.

title: B2B SALES EXECUTIVE – CONSULTING & PROFESSIONAL SERVICES
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION** 




**SALES EXECUTIVE – CONSULTING \& PROFESSIONAL SERVICES** 




**1\. Position Details** 




**Position:** 
 Sales Executive
 



**Function:** 
 Business Development \& Sales
 



**Company:** 
 Smartedge Consulting
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad / Telangana
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Business Development Manager / Director
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 Years
 



**Salary:** 
 ₹20,000 – ₹30,000 per month \+ Performance Incentives
 



**Travel:** 
 Local travel for client meetings, as required
 



  





  





**2\. About the Role** 




 Smartedge Consulting is looking for a
 **Sales Executive** 
 who can actively contribute to business growth by identifying prospects, generating leads, conducting structured follow\-ups, arranging client meetings and supporting the conversion of enquiries into consulting assignments.
 



 This is a
 **target\-driven, hands\-on sales role** 
 . The candidate should be comfortable with
 **telecalling, email/LinkedIn outreach, lead qualification, follow\-ups and meeting coordination** 
 .
 



 The role is suitable for someone who wants to build a career in
 **B2B consulting and professional\-services sales** 
 .
 



  





  





**3\. Key Responsibilities** 




**A. Lead Generation** 



* Identify prospective companies through online research, databases, LinkedIn, referrals and other sources.
* Generate new B2B leads through:
* Telephone calls
* Email campaigns
* LinkedIn outreach
* WhatsApp/business communication, where appropriate
* Existing client references
* Business directories and industry databases
* Build and maintain a prospect database with relevant contact details.
* Identify the decision\-makers and influencers within target organizations.



**B. Lead Qualification** 



* Understand the prospect's business requirement and identify potential consulting opportunities.
* Qualify leads based on:
* Requirement
* Organization size
* Industry
* Location
* Decision\-maker
* Budget/timing
* Urgency
* Record all lead information accurately in the CRM/lead tracker.



**C. Follow\-up \& Appointment Generation** 



* Make regular and systematic follow\-up calls with prospects.
* Follow up on enquiries, proposals and quotations.
* Arrange meetings between qualified prospects and Smartedge consultants/management.
* Maintain a daily follow\-up schedule and ensure no qualified lead is left unattended.
* Convert enquiries into
 **client meetings, proposals and opportunities** 
 .



**D. Sales Support** 



* Understand Smartedge's major consulting services and communicate their business benefits clearly.
* Coordinate with consultants for technical discussions and proposals.
* Follow up with clients after proposal submission.
* Track proposal status and expected closure dates.
* Support commercial discussions and closure under the direction of the reporting manager.



**E. Client Relationship Development** 



* Maintain professional communication with prospects and existing clients.
* Develop relationships with prospective customers for repeat and cross\-selling opportunities.
* Identify additional requirements that may lead to other Smartedge services.



  





  





**4\. Services to be Promoted** 




 The candidate will be trained on Smartedge's consulting and professional\-service offerings, including relevant areas such as:
 


* ISO / IMS / QEHS Consulting
* Information Security \& Business Continuity
* EHS \& Safety Services
* ESG \& Sustainability Consulting
* Energy \& Resource Efficiency
* Food Safety
* Supplier Sustainability
* EHS Managed Services
* Training \& Capability Development
* Business Performance / Operational Excellence



**The candidate is not expected to be a technical consultant.** 
 However, the candidate must be able to understand the basic business value of these services and communicate with prospective customers confidently.
 



  





  





**5\. Daily / Weekly Sales Activities** 




 The candidate is expected to maintain measurable sales activity, including:
 


* New prospect identification
* Outbound calls
* Email/LinkedIn outreach
* Lead qualification
* Follow\-ups
* Client meetings scheduled
* Proposals followed up
* Opportunities progressed
* CRM/lead tracker updates



 Performance will be reviewed based on
 **activity, qualified opportunities, meetings and business conversion** 
 , and not merely attendance.
 



  





  





**6\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 




 Indicative KPIs may include:
 



**KPI** 




**Measurement** 




 New Prospects
 



 Daily / Weekly
 



 Outbound Calls
 



 Daily
 



 New Leads Generated
 



 Weekly
 



 Qualified Leads
 



 Weekly
 



 Client Meetings / Appointments
 



 Weekly
 



 Proposal Follow\-ups
 



 Weekly
 



 Active Opportunities
 



 Monthly
 



 New Business Generated
 



 Monthly
 



 Conversion Ratio
 



 Monthly
 



 CRM / Tracker Discipline
 



 100%
 



 Targets will be finalized based on the assigned market/segment and business potential.
 



  





  





**7\. Candidate Profile** 




 We are looking for a
 **sales\-oriented and disciplined individual** 
 , preferably with:
 


* 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales, inside sales, tele\-sales, business development or professional services.
* Good telephone communication skills.
* Good English communication skills.
* Ability to speak confidently with business owners, managers and decision\-makers.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office / Google Workspace.
* Ability to use LinkedIn for prospecting.
* Willingness to make outbound calls and perform regular follow\-ups.
* Strong follow\-up discipline.
* Ability to work with targets and measurable KPIs.
* Willingness to learn technical consulting services.



 Experience in
 **ISO, certification, consulting, training, HR services, EHS, ESG, IT services or other B2B professional services** 
 will be an advantage.
 



  





  





**8\. Key Competencies** 




**Essential** 



* Communication
* Lead generation
* Telecalling
* Follow\-up
* Negotiation basics
* Customer handling
* Time management
* CRM / Excel discipline
* Target orientation
* Learning attitude



**Behavioural Expectations** 



* Proactive rather than waiting for leads
* Persistent but professional in follow\-ups
* Comfortable with rejection
* Data\-driven and organized
* Honest reporting of lead status
* Ownership of assigned targets
* Team\-oriented approach



  





  





**9\. What This Role Is NOT** 




 This position is
 **not primarily a customer\-service, back\-office or lead\-handling role** 
 .
 



 The selected candidate will be expected to:
 



**Find → Contact → Qualify → Follow Up → Arrange Meeting → Support Proposal → Progress Opportunity → Support Closure** 




 Candidates who are uncomfortable with
 **outbound calling, prospecting or sales targets** 
 may not be suitable for this position.
 



  





  





**10\. Compensation** 




**Fixed Salary:** 
 ₹20,000 – ₹30,000 per month, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated capability.
 



**Incentives:** 
 Additional performance\-linked incentives based on qualified opportunities, meetings and/or business conversion, as per the company's incentive structure.
 



 The company may offer higher compensation to candidates demonstrating relevant B2B consulting/professional\-services sales experience and a proven sales record.
 



  





  





**11\. Career Growth** 




 Successful performers can progress into roles such as:
 



**Sales Executive → Business Development Executive → Business Development Manager → Sales / Business Development Lead** 




 Growth will be based primarily on
 **sales performance, capability, ownership and contribution to business growth** 
 .
 



  





  





**12\. How to Apply** 




 Interested candidates should submit their
 **updated CV along with a brief summary of their sales experience, industries handled, and recent sales/lead\-generation responsibilities** 
 .
 



**Subject:** 
 Application – Sales Executive – Smartedge Consulting
 



**ABOUT SMARTEDGE CONSULTING** 




**Smartedge Consulting** 
 is a business consulting and professional services firm helping organizations
 **improve performance, strengthen governance, manage risk and build sustainable business systems** 
 .
 



 We work with organizations across
 **manufacturing, infrastructure, construction, pharmaceuticals, food, IT/ITES, logistics and other sectors** 
 , supporting them in areas such as:
 


* **Business Performance \& Operational Excellence**

* **Professional Training \& Capability Development**

 Our approach goes beyond obtaining certifications. We focus on
 **building practical systems that can be implemented, sustained and integrated into day\-to\-day business operations** 
 .
 



**Our Positioning** 




**Building Systems. Not Just Certificates.** 




 We work closely with clients to understand their business requirements, identify risks and gaps, develop practical solutions, support implementation and build organizational capability.
 



**Why Join Smartedge?** 




 At Smartedge, sales professionals get an opportunity to work in
 **B2B consulting and professional services** 
 , interact with business leaders and decision\-makers, understand diverse industries, and develop expertise across multiple consulting domains.
 



 The role offers a performance\-driven environment where
 **initiative, learning, business development capability and measurable results** 
 are recognized.

The founders are respected for their integrity, business acumen, and strong ability to connect suppliers with consumers across India.

**About Darwinbox:**
 Darwinbox is Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform. Brainchild of alumni from world's most distinguished organizations (McKinsey, EY, Google), we are the preferred choice of 850\+ global enterprises to manage their 2\.2 Million\+ employees across 100\+ countries.
   

  

 For three years in a row, we are the fastest growing HCM tech company in the Gartner’s Magic Quadrant for Cloud HCM Suites for enterprises with 1,000\+ employees.
   

  

 Darwinbox's new\-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start\-ups – Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Adani Wilmar, DLF, Crisil, JG Summit Group, Cebu Pacific Air, Nivea, etc.
   

  

 The vision of Darwinbox to build a world\-class product company from Asia and is backed by marquee global investors like Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, and Lightspeed Venture Partners and Microsoft.
   

  

**About The Role:**
 As we scale our Enterprise motion, we’re looking for a specialist who can crack net\-new strategic accounts and land first meetings with Group CHROs, CXOs, and transformation leaders.
   

  

 This is not a volume outbound role; It’s a strategic account\-opening role!!!
   

  

 You’ll identify the right accounts, map complex stakeholder networks, run multi\-threaded outreach, leverage AI and research tools intelligently, and create opportunities that most teams assume are impossible
   

  

**What’s Expected of You:**
* You’ll build your own pipeline.
* You’ll use AI, deep research, LinkedIn, executive referrals, and creative outbound plays to identify and engage decision\-makers.
* You’ll think less about “cadence completion” and more about account penetration.
* One week, you might build a stakeholder map across a large conglomerate. Another week, you might orchestrate a multi\-threaded approach across HR, IT, and business leadership to land a single strategic meeting.
* When the door opens, you hand the opportunity to the enterprise sales team and move on to the next account


**Who will thrive here :**
* People who get energy from winning difficult accounts.
* People who’ve personally opened net\-new enterprise logos.
* People who use AI every day—not because it’s trendy, but because it helps them research better, personalize deeper, and reach executives more intelligently.
* People who can show us one creative outbound strategy they designed and the result it produced.


**What we’re looking for:**
* 5 to 10yrs years in B2B SaaS in the inside sales function/SDR.
* Proven experience opening net\-new enterprise or conglomerate accounts
* Strong track record of reaching senior decision\-makers and creating first meetings
* Enterprise SaaS background preferred; HCM/HR Tech ideal
* Experience with platforms such as Workday, SuccessFactors, Oracle, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise ecosystems is a plus

**Work you’ll do:**
 Configure and enhance Five9 ACD capabilities: skills, queues, IVR/IVA, call flows, routing strategies, agent profiles, and campaigns.

* Create technical documentation: configuration specs, runbooks, test plans, deployment steps, and operational handover.

* Working knowledge of telephony fundamentals (SIP, PSTN basics, call flows, DTMF, codecs concepts) sufficient to troubleshoot with telecom partners.
* Strong debugging skills across logs, API traces, and platform configuration; ability to translate business requirements into technical designs.


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Experience with WFO/WFM/QM integrations, speech analytics, or AI/IVA platforms.
* Data/BI skills: SQL, Power BI/Tableau, building KPI layers for contact center reporting.
* Experience with SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, and enterprise identity patterns.
* Prior work in regulated environments (HIPAA, PCI, SOX, CJIS) and secure SDLC.

title: Inside Sales Executive
description:
**Company:** 
 Ayushman Surgicare
 



**Department:** 
 Sales \& Patient Acquisition
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 years preferred
 



**Industry:** 
 Healthcare / Hospital Services
 







**About Ayushman Surgicare:** 




 Ayushman Surgicare is a healthcare coordination platform that helps patients connect with the right doctors and hospitals and supports them throughout their surgical journey through a structured 90\-Day Care Buddy model.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 The Inside Sales Executive will be responsible for handling healthcare enquiries, understanding patient requirements, qualifying leads, and converting suitable enquiries into doctor consultations, hospital visits, admissions, and eligible treatment or surgery opportunities. The role combines inside sales, patient counselling, lead management, follow\-ups, and healthcare coordination.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Lead Management** 



* Handle leads from WhatsApp, phone calls, website enquiries, digital campaigns, and referrals.
* Contact new leads promptly and understand their healthcare requirements.
* Update patient information accurately in the CRM.
* Categorize leads as hot, warm, or cold and maintain the follow\-up pipeline.
* Re\-engage old, inactive, and postponed cases.



**2\. Patient Counselling \& Requirement Understanding** 



* Understand the patient's stated problem, diagnosis, treatment recommendation, and preferred location/hospital.
* Explain Ayushman Surgicare's coordination services clearly.
* Help patients understand available doctor and hospital options.
* Address basic questions about appointments, diagnostics, estimates, insurance coordination, and hospital processes.
* Maintain respectful, empathetic, and trustworthy communication.



**3\. Appointment \& Consultation Conversion** 



* Convert qualified enquiries into doctor consultations.
* Schedule appointments and coordinate with hospital/doctor teams.
* Confirm appointments and reduce no\-shows through reminders.
* Follow up after consultation to understand the patient's next step.
* Track consultation outcomes in the CRM.



**4\. Surgery \& IPD Follow\-up** 



* Follow up with qualified surgical cases after consultation.
* Coordinate estimate discussions with the relevant hospital team.
* Track patient decisions, expected admission dates, and pending requirements.
* Coordinate handover to the Care Buddy / hospital coordination team.
* Follow each case until admission, conversion, or closure.



  





**Daily Sales Process:** 




*New Lead → First Call / WhatsApp → Qualification → Doctor Consultation → Hospital / Treatment → Admission / Surgery → Care Buddy → Follow\-up* 




 The role requires consistent follow\-up at every stage of the patient journey.
 



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):** 



* New leads contacted
* Contact rate
* Qualified leads
* Consultation bookings
* Consultation attendance
* Follow\-up completion
* Hospital visits / IPD
* Surgery conversions
* Revenue generated
* Lead response time
* CRM accuracy



  





**Indicative Daily Activity Targets:** 



* 50–80 calls, depending on lead volume and campaign mix.
* 30\+ meaningful conversations with prospective patients.
* 10–15 qualified opportunities where lead quality supports the target.
* 5–10 consultation bookings depending on campaign volume.
* 100% CRM updates for handled leads and pending follow\-ups.



 Targets may be revised based on business volume, campaign performance, lead quality, and management priorities.
 



  





**Required Skills:** 



* Excellent verbal communication and telephone etiquette.
* Strong sales, persuasion, and negotiation skills.
* Good Telugu \+ English communication preferred; Hindi is an advantage.
* Strong follow\-up discipline and target orientation.
* Basic computer skills with Excel / Google Sheets.
* Ability to use CRM, WhatsApp Business, and digital lead\-management tools.
* Ability to work under targets and maintain accurate records.



  





**Preferred Experience:** 




 Experience in healthcare sales, hospital sales, medical tourism, insurance sales, diagnostic sales, tele calling, inside sales, B2C sales, or patient relationship management will be preferred.
 



  





**Personal Attributes:** 



* Target\-oriented and commercially aware.
* Confident, patient, and empathetic.
* Good listener with strong questioning skills.
* Persistent with follow\-ups without being aggressive.
* Professional and courteous with patients and families.
* Quick learner and comfortable working with processes and technology.
* Responsible and trustworthy with patient information.
* Team player who coordinates effectively with hospitals and internal teams.



  





**Internal Team Coordination:** 



* **Digital Marketing:** 
 Receive and understand campaign\-generated leads.
* **Inside Sales:** 
 Lead qualification, follow\-up, and conversion.
* **Care Buddy Team:** 
 Patient handover and ongoing support.
* **Hospital Coordination:** 
 Appointments, estimates, admissions, and discharge.
* **Business Development:** 
 Hospital and corporate partnership coordination.
* **Management:** 
 Sales reporting, targets, and performance review.



  





**Compensation \& Growth:** 



* **Salary:** 
 Best in Industry
* **Incentives:** 
 Attractive performance\-based incentives
* **Benefits:** 
 Training, recognition, and career growth opportunities based on performance.



  





**Career Growth:** 




 Inside Sales Executive → Senior Inside Sales Executive → Team Leader – Inside Sales → Sales Manager → Business Development / Patient Acquisition Manager.
 



  





**Important Role Boundary:** 




 The Inside Sales Executive is responsible for communication, qualification, coordination, and sales conversion. The role must not provide medical diagnosis, treatment advice, clinical recommendations, or make clinical decisions. Medical questions should be directed to the appropriate qualified healthcare professional.
 



  





**Our Mission:** 



* “Don't just generate a lead. Build a relationship, assist the patient and complete the healthcare journey."



  





**Apply / Contact:** 




**Phone / WhatsApp:** 
 \+91 70369 43189 / \+91 73961 12346
 




**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Company:** 
 Ayushman Surgicare

 **drive growth** 
 .

 **owning numbers, solving problems and moving quickly**

**What You'll Own**




**Blinkit \& Zepto Business Management**



* Own the day\-to\-day business across Blinkit and Zepto

**Inventory \& PO Management**



* Track SKU\-level inventory and availability across cities and dark stores

* Manage the complete
 **PO lifecycle** 
 from PO creation, acceptance, fulfilment, dispatches, fill rates and cancellations
* Identify inventory gaps and work with the platforms to improve availability and distribution
* Maintain strong in\-stock rates across priority SKUs



**Quick Commerce Advertising**



* Own
 **Blinkit and Zepto performance advertising**
* Plan and execute campaigns to drive sales and product visibility
* Manage budgets, bids, keywords, placements and campaign optimization
* Monitor
 **ROAS, CAC, sales, impressions, clicks and conversion rates**
* Identify high\-performing and under\-performing SKUs and optimize spend accordingly
* Continuously test campaigns, products and strategies to improve advertising efficiency



**Category \& Sales Growth**



* Track daily/weekly/monthly sales performance
* Analyse performance at
 **SKU, city, platform and category level**
* Identify opportunities to increase sales, visibility and market share
* Recommend pricing, promotions, assortment and advertising strategies
* Monitor competitor pricing, assortment and promotional activity
* Work towards improving
 **GMV, margins, ROAS, availability and overall channel profitability**



**Reporting \& Analytics**



* Build and maintain dashboards/reports for Blinkit and Zepto
* Track key KPIs and identify trends and anomalies
* Translate data into clear actions rather than simply reporting numbers
* Present regular performance updates and growth opportunities to the team



**Key KPIs**




 You will be directly accountable for metrics such as:
 


* **GMV / Net Sales**
* **Month\-on\-month growth**
* **SKU availability / in\-stock rate**
* **PO fill rate**
* **ROAS**
* **Advertising spend efficiency**
* **Conversion rate**
* **Organic \& paid visibility**
* **SKU productivity**
* **Contribution margin / profitability**



  





**Who We're Looking For**




 We're looking for someone who is
 **analytical and execution\-oriented** 
 . You should have:
 


* **2\+ years of experience** 
 in quick commerce, e\-commerce, marketplace management or category management
* Hands\-on experience with
 **Blinkit and/or Zepto**
* Strong understanding of quick\-commerce operations
* Experience managing
 **platform advertising/performance ads**
* Understanding of inventory management and PO/fulfilment processes
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and comfort working with data
* Ability to analyse SKU\-level performance and identify actionable insights
* Strong communication and follow\-up skills
* Ability to work independently and take ownership
* Comfort working in a
 **fast\-paced, high\-growth environment**



  





**What Makes This Role Different**




 This isn't a role where you'll simply maintain listings and send weekly reports.
 



**You'll own the channel.** 




 You'll have the opportunity to build Absolut Pet's presence on India's fastest\-growing commerce platforms, decide where we spend our advertising rupees, identify which products and cities have the biggest opportunities, and work directly with the platforms to drive growth.
 



 You'll have significant visibility with the founding/management team and the opportunity to grow with a rapidly scaling pet\-care brand.

**Apply now and tell us about the quick\-commerce businesses, platforms and categories you've managed.**

 The Assistant Manager – Business Development will support the expansion of the company’s retail footprint across South India by identifying high\-potential markets, evaluating suitable retail locations, coordinating commercial negotiations, and ensuring timely execution of new store openings.

 \- Track upcoming malls, commercial developments, high streets, and retail projects.
   

  

 2\. Site Identification \& Evaluation

 \- Competition

 \- Provide regular market intelligence to the management team.

 \- Coordinate prope

 6\. Broker \& Developer Network Management

 \- Property consultants
   

 \- Local brokers
   

 \- Mall developers
   

 \- Landlords
   

 \- IPCs
   

 \- Commercial real estate companies
   

 \- Develop a strong property sourcing network across assigned South Indian markets.
   

  

 7\. MIS \& Reporting

 \- Markets under evaluation

 \- Commercial negotiations
   

 \- Approved sites
   

 \- Lease status
   

 \- Store opening timelines
   

 \- Prepare weekly and monthly expansion MIS for management review.

 \- Telangana
   

 \- Andhra Pradesh
   

 \- Kerala

 Experience
